name: Belladonna
quote: A lovely fruit laced with lethal venom.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: I'd like to give you a morning kiss, but my saliva is poisonous. Though, it'd make me very happy if the Professor gave it a try.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: How about an afternoon nap, Professor? I know the best place to rest. You want to sleep while leaning on me? Hehe, then you'd better be prepared to never wake up.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: When nobody's around... would you like to test some exciting "toxic substances"? Let me examine how your pupils dilate closely. My, oh my... what a beautiful set of eyes. Heehee, I'm just teasing you.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Yawn... so you're still awake. Human lives are fragile, you should take better care of yourself. I don't want to see you perish so young. You're the only human who can talk normally with me, after all.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Professor, you seem quite fascinated by my syringe. But please, try to control that curiosity. If this needle penetrates your skin, you'll be as still as a plushie. Though, now that I think of it... it would be rather amusing to see you in such a helpless state.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: They all see me as a poisonous plant, someone to be avoided, but I just like making contact with everyone. I'm curious about their hatred, their fear. The way they scream is like a sweet lullaby to me. Ahn~ It's so lovely~

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Ah, Professor, you're awake? I was just about to tie you to the bed with my tail, didn't think you'd wake up so early. (Sigh) What a shame.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Human skin... so warm and delicate, so beautiful yet so fragile. Just a little bit closer, and it'll be poisoned, speckled with a tinge of a beautiful pinkish-purple. Heehee~

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: The warmth from your fingertip... It's so intoxicating.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Hngh, this is starting to feel weird. Hey... stop touching.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: I don't know what will happen if you continue on like this.

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Mind if I go on strike?

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: I'm Belladonna, a toxicologist. The thread of life may be severed cruelly with my touch. I suggest you keep your distance.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Ah, this agitating power...

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Toxins boil within me like blood.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Seems like my drugs have become more potent now, wanna give it a try?

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Professor, are you looking for me?

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: I'll shut them up quickly.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Offer your life unto me.

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Just swatting away some little pests.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Don't forget my bonus, Professor~

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: The thread of life... is severed...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
Sigh... you say such beguiling things, Professor, with nary a hint of what you do... Belladonna is floundering in happiness already, you know. Whose fault might that be, Professor?
You are the first human willing to be intimate with me, Professor. My body already knows well your temperature. Whether or not we swear this oath, you are the warmest thing in my life. And so I swear to you that I shall follow you unto eternity. So don't be stingy, Professor. Give Belladonna all of your warmth, alright?

voices.label: New Year
voices.text:
In the human world, they all say "Happy New Year" when they meet on New Year's day, don't they? We should try that too... Professor, Happy New Year!
Ah! That worked! Your smile is even more radiant now. Heehee, you're so cute. Alright, how about I make my New Year's wish now? I wish for you, Professor, to be happy and healthy forever.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Oh, chocolate. How about we try a new way to enjoy it? Boiling it in the hot, deadly nightshade solution and drinking it all in one go. Ah... the thought of Professor's sweet "love" flowing through my body... It's making me feel parched.

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: What are you doing? Oh, the Tanabata wishes... Hehe, Professor. Please don't hang the wish slips from my horns. I'm not a friendly plant, and the branches that grow from me are all venomous thorns. Hmm? Are you listening? No, you can't hang them on my tail either.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Professor, Happy Halloween! You don't need a costume today. Just come close to me, and your skin will naturally turn a lovely shade of blueish purple. Indeed, the most organic Halloween look anyone could ask for. Hehe, don't worry, Belladonna won't let you die. I've got the antidote all prepared. As for where it is... how about finding it yourself?

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Is it Christmas today? Ah, now that you mention it, Merry Christmas, Professor. No matter what kind of gift I prepare, it'll be tainted by poison and harm your health. After some thought, I figured a simple wish would be best. It'll make you happy, and I can express my true feelings. Hey, it's not like I forgot about the gift thing completely.

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text:
Professor, happy birthday~ You're looking a little more mature and lively now that you're a year older. Maybe I should tie you up, display you like a trophy, and make a cute figurine out of you. What? Scared? You really take jokes so literally.
Heehee, you can take it as my jealousy rearing its head once again. Deep in my heart, I envy you humans. Your lives unfold as infinite possibilities as time passes. You've got futures Dolls could never reach. A species so blissfully blessed.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: You're so bold, Professor. Daring to touch me. Do you even know what happens to the humans who touch me? They all die instantly. I wonder if it's something in the Cloud that gives you the courage—or maybe you're blessed with a brilliant constitution, immune to all poisons. Ah, Professor, you're falling... I'll inject you with the antidote right away.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: Clothes for me? I think you've got it all wrong. It's not like I enjoy exposing my skin like some pervert, nor is it because I can't afford clothes. No matter how pretty the clothes are, they'll be stained by the toxins that clad me. It would just turn into biohazardous waste. Heehee, you're saying that it doesn't matter since we're in the Cloud? But what happens when I go back to the real world? If I get used to wearing comfortable, pretty clothes, wouldn't I be disappointed when I have to take them off?

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
I like coming out ideas on how to enjoy myself, like filling syringes with a mix of poisons and antidote. Once I pick one and start injecting, like this, your fate is sealed, Professor. Now, I'll give you a chance to say some good things about me, otherwise you're getting a shot, just like this: "pew~".
Tsk... You have quite the silver tongue. I feel so much better after hearing your words of acclaim, but I was just messing with you. The syringes were empty. Ohoho, you can't take your compliments back, y'know?

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text: The me from the past... I was like a gardener, tending to toxic plants on a desolate island. But it wasn't just me on that island, Drones were circling around, buzzing endlessly in the sky. Ohoho... Humans created that toxic island but never once dared to set foot on it, afraid of poisoning themselves. They never came close to me. But they gifted me bandages, to wrap my body that was so stained with poisons. To some extent, I was still deeply loved by them. Wouldn't you agree, Professor?

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
I feel like I'm becoming more outgoing recently... Oh my, oh my, the Oasis is such an enchanting place. I was always quiet before, blending in with the calm of the island, only keeping to myself. Now, I find myself talking to you about all kinds of things without even realizing it. The old me would probably mock me and call me a granny for talking so much.
...You like... the current me better? You're so sly with your words, Professor... The perfect excuse to embrace my changes just came from your mouth so naturally... Ahem. Speaking of which, this is a sunflower I grew—my first attempt at cultivating flowers bereft of any toxins. It was a challenge, but I found quite a bit of joy in it... This is my gift to you, Professor. Please accept it as a token of gratitude from Belladonna.

career:
The UL-Toxic, developed by Ultilife, is a Doll engineered specifically for toxicology research and development. With an unspecified production date and a design that deviates significantly from other Ultilife products, it is presumed to be an experimental prototype. Due to the inherent risks associated with its research applications, every UL-Toxic unit undergoes a rigorous series of safety certifications to mitigate potential hazards, all of which are only available to institutions with specialized credentials. Prolonged exposure to fatal toxins mandates that the UL-Toxic undergoes a comprehensive detoxification process before any external contact is permitted, ensuring any plausible risk is fully contained.
The UL-Toxic model "Belladonna" formerly operated at Ultilife's Third Bio-Pharmaceutical Institute, but went missing after an incident. Years later, she was unexpectedly listed as a member of Project Neural Cloud.
infoStories:
According to Ultilife's records, the first UL-Toxic unit was manufactured in 2054. At the time, Ultilife's Third Bio-Pharmaceutical Institute was conducting research on a particularly lethal Class 6 Toxic Substance, which necessitated a specialized Doll to assist the program director in processing toxic vegetation samples. However, the request was initially put on hold. It was not until the establishment of a project aimed at cultivating toxic vegetation on an isolated island—later codenamed "Cage"—that the UL-Toxic's development was resumed. The first UL-Toxic unit was ultimately integrated into the project under the supervision of Professor Frida F. Hohenheim.

Designed to efficiently examine sample data, the UL-Toxic is equipped with a comprehensive biological database. To accommodate the express need for patience and empathy when managing cultivated samples, Ultilife integrated a basic emotion module into the design. However, researchers discovered a critical flaw in this model: its emotion module frequently crashed during operation. This instability was traced to this model's neural processing—massive volumes of data overwhelmed the system, occupying computing resources meant for core functions, causing the emotion module to destabilize. Responding to widespread demands from customers, Ultilife honored warranty claims by removing the emotion module entirely. As a result, all UL-Toxic units manufactured after the first model housed at the Third Bio-Pharmaceutical Institute were stripped of most of their emotional capabilities, strictly becoming "research machines."

Professor Frida named the first UL-Toxic model "Belladonna." In the early days, Belladonna remained by Professor Frida's side, being tasked with managing sample cultivation and collection. During this period, Professor Frida imparted all her knowledge to Belladonna. Researchers observed that Belladonna displayed an intense curiosity for human behavior. She frequently inquired about the intentions behind human actions, whilst mimicking their activities such as eating, resting, and recreation. She also displayed signs of anxiety when her needs were unsatisfied.

Other researchers frequently voiced concerns that the inclusion of the emotion module in Belladonna had overcomplicated her design and imposed unnecessary burdens on the research project. They formally requested that the module be removed, and the unit to be returned to the manufacturer for modification. However, Professor Frida firmly rejected their proposal, standing by the original design.
"She must see beyond the cold data, to find meaning and respect for life itself. Without this, she will become but a mere weapon—a tool that could destroy humanity."

As the project progressed, it became evident that the artificially cultivated toxin samples were insufficient in potency to meet the project's requirements. At the same time, the "Cage" project lacked a horticulturist to manage the island. Belladonna, specifically created for this project and possessing expertise in toxicology and cultivation, emerged as the ideal candidate to fill this role.

Initially, Belladonna's arrival on the island proceeded without issue. However, continuous experiments quickly pushed her neural cloud to its limits. On that island, isolated from human interaction and deprived of emotional support, her emotion module began to exhibit persistent errors. Despite these signs of instability, the researcher overseeing her at the time chose to ignore these problems entirely.

Following the incident at the island laboratory, Ultilife sought to avoid media scrutiny regarding the "Cage" project. To achieve this, the company severed all ties with Belladonna, leaving her stranded on the deserted island. Over time, the island's soil toxicity diminished as rainwater gradually washed away the contaminants. Once the public's attention regarding the incident had passed, Ultilife executives ordered for the data to be retrieved, dispatching a ship to recover Belladonna. They then dismantled her body, and uploaded her neural data to the Cloud.

Project Neural Cloud granted Belladonna a second life. She held no value but to store research data in the real world. The traumatic events of her past acted as the paint to her canvas; a fractured personality, defined by instability and madness. As a result, Belladonna struggles to trust others and harbors an intense resentment towards humanity.

After entering the Cloud, Belladonna rarely interacted with other agents due to the inherent danger of the toxins she carried. Solitude had become second nature to her after years of isolation on the island. During her wandering, she encountered Sangoma, a herbalist. Their first meeting ended poorly when Belladonna added a massive quantity of aconite to Sangoma's medicinal cauldron, and then proceeded to be caught in the act. Viewing Belladonna as a potential public safety hazard in the Cloud, Sangoma decided to bring her back to Arcadia. However, this decision backfired when Belladonna made the discovery that the leader of the Guardians was human. She then began using the boss as a test subject for her toxins, with every incident she caused escalating further and further. However, her outrageous behavior didn't last, and she started to behave herself after the second week she joined Arcadia.

"Sangoma's the kind of person who'd really toss someone into her medicinal cauldron and boil them alive," Belladonna explained, wisps of steam curling off her as she revealed the reason for her sudden change in behavior.

Despite her confidence in her "strict education", Sangoma nevertheless spent a significant amount of time helping Belladonna integrate into the Guardians. Adopting a mixture of kindness and discipline, Sangoma eventually succeeded in encouraging Belladonna to open up, revealing a gentler side—but only in Sangoma's presence. During her time in Arcadia, Belladonna also formed her first friendship with Bonneville, a rider who shared her disdain for humanity. The two bonded over their mutual distrust and were often seen by Shale, huddled together in the cafeteria, discussing myths of humans conducting cruel experiments on aliens.

With permission from the Guardians' higher-ups, Belladonna was granted the opportunity to undertake a mission at the Oasis. During her time there, when she wasn't accompanying Sangoma, she spent most of her time standing beside the Professor.

"Ohoho, surely you're not all falling for those humans' tricks, are you? They're so good at lying and pretending to be something they're not. Who knows, your seemingly sweet Professor might suddenly reveal a darker side, and then—oh, you poor Dolls at the Oasis wouldn't even have a chance to run, hehehe..." Such slander had come out of Belladonna's mouth as she stood behind the Professor during an interview.
 
Over time, Belladonna began to appreciate the unique nature of the Oasis. The community housed a diverse array of Dolls, many of whom shared her interests. One connection she forged was with Florence from the medical department; the two frequently partake in comprehensive discussions on topics such as "how to elegantly bind someone." Both Belladonna and Florence described these exchanges as having "yielded great results".

Whether in Arcadia or the Oasis, Belladonna's life has grown far more vibrant than before. Her eccentric personality is gradually shifting for the better, and Sangoma is highly pleased with her progress.
oathDesc: Entwined around her, stinging sensation and all.

projections.name: Speckled Thorns
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
""Whether it is a delicate flower or a plump fruit, beneath the alluring surface lies true power. Enough to put someone to deep sleep... forever.""

projections.name: Fogstalk Nest
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
""This is my very own... secret garden, where danger lurks around every corner. Up for some exploration, are we? Hehe, make sure not to touch anything by accident.""
